create_CGLChoosePixelFormat: create a CGL pixel format by choosing from available renderers with specified attributes
create_CGLCreateContext: create a CGL OpenGL context from a pixel format object on macOS
create_CGLSetCurrentContext: set a CGL context as the current OpenGL context for the calling thread
create_CGLLockContext: lock a CGL context to ensure exclusive access during OpenGL operations
create_CGLOpenGLProfile: create an OpenGL profile enum value specifying GL version compatibility for CGL
